description: AutoPilot runs the AI Text Generator with Claude, but the user has no Anthropic key, so the block answers with its sign-in card and AutoPilot stops. Once the user saves a key on the card, the chat carries on: AutoPilot runs the block again and it calls the provider (this server) with that key. copilot-connect-card-journey.spec.ts follows it.
title: A line about the sea

turns.text: I'll write that line with the AI Text Generator, using Claude.

input.prompt: Write one line about the sea.

turns.text: It needs your Anthropic API key first. Connect one on the card and I'll carry on.

turns.expect_user_text: I've configured the required credentials. Please re-run this step now.
turns.text: Thanks, running it again with your key.

input.prompt: Write one line about the sea.

turns.text: Done: the AI Text Generator wrote your line with your Anthropic key.
